units.source_text: “棋局越演越烈，真了不起啊！这……”大竹七段反复地说。

en.t: "The game is growing more and more intense. It is truly remarkable! This..." Ohtake 7-dan said again and again.

units.source_text: 在思考黑下一手131时，午饭时间已到。

en.t: While they were considering Black's next move, move 131, the time for lunch had already arrived.

units.source_text: 这一刻，列席的岩本六段也感叹：“遭到猛烈的攻击，挨了厉害的一手。

en.t: At that moment, Iwamoto 6-dan, who was also present, sighed in admiration: "He has come under a fierce attack and been hit by a formidable move.
It truly shakes heaven and earth!

units.source_text: 眼看快要收官，不料竟遭对手杀了个回马枪……”

en.t: Just when it looked as if the endgame was near, he was unexpectedly struck by a counterattack from his opponent..."
